reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web utility that lets users copy rendered KaTeX formulas as LaTeX in several common delimiters, with mouse and keyboard interactions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 中渲染的 KaTeX 数学公式提供便捷的 LaTeX 复制和格式选择交互。
summaries.en: Adds convenient LaTeX copying and format selection interactions for rendered KaTeX formulas in DeepSeek Harness Web.

capabilities: Reads rendered KaTeX annotations in the web client
Adds formula hover, keyboard, and context-menu interactions
Copies LaTeX formula text to the user clipboard
Modifies and cleans up related client-side DOM and event handlers
